# Congress.gov

> > Official repository of U.S. federal legislative information including bills, public laws, committee hearings, and Congressional records from the U.S. Government Publishing Office.

Congress.gov provides comprehensive access to legislative documents from the House of Representatives and Senate across multiple Congressional sessions (106th-119th Congresses). The site serves as the authoritative source for tracking legislation, public laws, committee hearings, and Congressional resolutions, maintained by the Government Publishing Office and the Library of Congress.

## Key Topics

- Public Laws
- 117th Congress
- 119th Congress
- House of Representatives
- Senate
- Congressional Hearings
- Bills and Resolutions
- United States Code
- Department of Veterans Affairs
- Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure
- U.S. Government Publishing Office
- Federal Legislation
- Banking Regulation
- Armed Forces
- Homeland Security

## Major Public Laws

- [SFC Heath Robinson PACT Act - Public Law 117-168](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ168/PLAW-117publ168.htm): Veterans toxic exposure healthcare and benefits expansion (117th)
- [Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act - Public Law 106-102](https://www.congress.gov/106/plaws/publ102/PLAW-106publ102.htm): Financial Services Modernization Act repealing Glass-Steagall (106th)
- [VOCA Fix to Sustain Crime Victims Fund Act - Public Law 117-27](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ27/PLAW-117publ27.htm): Expands Crime Victims Fund with deferred prosecution agreements (117th)
- [SPEED Recovery Act - Public Law 117-189](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ189/PLAW-117publ189.htm): Increases disaster relief simplified procedure threshold (117th)
- [Firefighter PFAS Protection Act - Public Law 117-248](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ248/PLAW-117publ248.htm): FEMA guidance on PFAS exposure in firefighting foam and equipment (117th)
- [Sami's Law - Public Law 117-330](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ330/PLAW-117publ330.htm): GAO study on rideshare safety and assault prevention measures (117th)
- [K-12 Cybersecurity Act of 2021 - Public Law 117-47](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ47/PLAW-117publ47.htm): CISA cybersecurity support and guidance for K-12 schools (117th)

## Veterans Affairs and Defense

- [SFC Heath Robinson PACT Act - Public Law 117-168](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ168/PLAW-117publ168.htm): Veterans toxic exposure healthcare and benefits expansion (117th)
- [Patient Advocate Tracker Act - Public Law 117-175](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ175/PLAW-117publ175.htm): VA electronic complaint tracking system for patient advocacy (117th)
- [Veteran Healthcare Worker Recruitment Act - Public Law 117-67](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ67/PLAW-117publ67.htm): VA recruitment of separating military healthcare workers (117th)
- [H.R. 6823 - TBI Diagnostic Technology Pilot Program](https://www.congress.gov/119/bills/hr6823/BILLS-119hr6823ih.htm): DoD pilot for traumatic brain injury diagnostic technology (119th)

## Current Bills and Resolutions (119th Congress)

- [H.R. 6823 - TBI Diagnostic Technology Pilot Program](https://www.congress.gov/119/bills/hr6823/BILLS-119hr6823ih.htm): DoD pilot for traumatic brain injury diagnostic technology (119th)
- [S. 2503 - ROTOR Act (Aviation Safety)](https://www.congress.gov/119/bills/s2503/BILLS-119s2503rs.htm): FAA rulemaking on ADS-B requirements for rotorcraft airspace (119th)
- [H.R. 1294 - CBP Image Technician Pilot Program](https://www.congress.gov/119/bills/hr1294/BILLS-119hr1294ih.htm): CBP Office of Field Operations image technician pilot program (119th)
- [H. Res. 953 - Rules for H.R. 6703 Consideration](https://www.congress.gov/119/bills/hres953/BILLS-119hres953rh.htm): House resolution establishing debate rules for H.R. 6703 (119th)

## Congressional Hearings and Reports

- [The State of Climate Science and Why It Matters](https://www.congress.gov/116/chrg/CHRG-116hhrg35231/CHRG-116hhrg35231.htm): House Science Committee hearing on climate change (Feb 2019, 116th)

## Regulatory and Administrative Laws

- [Government Publishing Office Director Term Limits - Public Law 117-213](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ213/PLAW-117publ213.htm): Establishes 10-year term for GPO Director with Senate confirmation (117th)
- [Low Power Protection Act - Public Law 117-344](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ344/PLAW-117publ344.htm): FCC rulemaking on Class A television licensing requirements (117th)
- [Asian Pacific American Museum Commission Act - Public Law 117-140](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ140/PLAW-117publ140.htm): Establishes commission to study national AAPI museum creation (117th)

## Optional

- [Charles P. Nord Post Office Designation - Public Law 117-292](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ292/PLAW-117publ292.htm): Names Perham, Minnesota post office for Charles P. Nord (117th)
- [Matthew R. Turcotte Post Office Designation - Public Law 117-87](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ87/PLAW-117publ87.htm): Names Slatersville, RI post office for Matthew R. Turcotte (117th)
- [Don Young Recognition Act - Public Law 117-358](https://www.congress.gov/117/plaws/publ358/PLAW-117publ358.htm): Designates Alaska mountain as Mount Young for Rep. Don Young (117th)
